title: Minimum Swaps to Arrange a Binary Grid
description: Calculate minimum swaps to make all rows below the diagonal contain only zeros.

steps.note: Calculate last index of '1' for each row: [[0,0,1], [1,1,0], [0,1,0]] -> [2, 1, 1]
For row 0, target is 2 (need at least 2 trailing zeros). Current trailing zero counts: [2, 1, 1]. Row 0 has 2, which is >= 2. No swap needed.
For row 1, target is 1. Row 1 has count 1. Row 2 has count 1. Row 1 satisfies condition.
